description.value: That Churro Place is a seasonal street vendor at the base of Mt. Morrisey at Sun Peaks resort, specializing in Brazilian stuffed churros—cylindrical fried dough filled with sweet fillings, distinct from traditional Spanish churros. The business was inspired by the founders' travels eating churros around the world and aims to bring the Brazilian stuffed churro experience to the Sun Peaks mountain community.
